notes: Smoke detection reflight. Overheated/smouldering cabin materials (Kapton wire insulation, Silicone, Lampwick) -> fuel_phase solid, fuel_class cabin_material. Detection study, not a burn test: no O2 or pressure columns -> blank (excluded from gap map, as intended); outcome set to 'unknown' (burned/extinguished do not apply). Airflow = inlet velocity (cm/s). Main metric Rt/R0 = smoke particle-size growth ratio (detection-relevant quantity).
